item.text:
The randomized `ProgressEntry::next_send` simulation passes 300 leader-log/purge/snapshot configurations, including successful and conflicting follower responses. It never returned `Inflight::None` while the follower was behind and always converged to the leader’s last log. That is a verified replication-liveness invariant, not a new defect.

Updated library counts:

| Configuration | Result |
|---|---|
| default | 196 pass |
| `storage-v2` | 196 pass |
| `compat,serde` | 198 pass |
| `generic-snapshot-data` | 207 pass |
| `compat` alone | fails to compile (F11) |

The audit remains at eleven confirmed findings. The new model test is [audit_next_send_test.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/openraft/src/progress/entry/audit_next_send_test.rs), with its run output at [next-send-model-stdout.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit/logs/next-send-model-stdout.txt). It is included in the regenerated [openraft-audit-tests.patch](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit/diagnostics/openraft-audit-tests.patch).

Full details, reproduction commands, and all findings are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md); artifacts are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit).
